# SportZoneBD

> SportZoneBD is a Bangladesh-focused sports website for live and upcoming match listings, streaming channels, video highlights and league standings.

Canonical URL: https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/
Primary language: English
Region: Bangladesh

## Public pages

- [Home](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/): live and upcoming match listings, featured channels and highlights.
- [Matches](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/matches): live, upcoming and finished match listings.
- [Channels](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/channels): streaming channel directory.
- [Categories](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/categories): channel categories.
- [Highlights](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/highlights): video highlights.
- [Standings](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/standings): league tables.
- [Subscriptions](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/subscriptions): premium plan details.
- [About](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/about): app information, version and release notes.
- [Terms of Service](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/terms-of-service)
- [Privacy Policy](https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/privacy-policy)

## Notes

- Pages are rendered client-side; match, channel, highlight and standings data is fetched at runtime.
- Match, channel, category and event detail pages use ids or slugs in the URL and are not listed here.
- Machine-readable discovery files: https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/sitemap.xml, https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/robots.txt, https://sport-zone-bd.vercel.app/ai-catalog.json
